description: Whether it's for a birthday party, a homecoming event, baptism, Christmas party, or any holiday celebration, you'll be able to create wonderful decors with these 12-inch Latex Balloons by Unique Industries! Each set includes 10 Latex Party Balloons that can measure up to 12 inches per balloon when inflated. Package comes uninflated when shipped. Create your very own radiant balloon arch for your guests to walk through, a table centerpiece, a hanged decor, and a lot more!
